summary: Each Oh My Pi, Claude Code and serving-port session gets a durable JetStream pull consumer s-<session id> on ENVOY_NOTIFICATIONS (agent subject plus followed stored topics), created and owned by the listener that holds the session's registration. That listener relays each message in order on the unstored core subject notifications.envoy.deliver.<id> (HTTP prompt_async for serving-port sessions); the plugin answers received at decode, progress while held, done after the transcript write, and only done acks the stored message. Every new relay start restarts the consumer at its ack floor so order holds; the plugin's persisted ledger (from sjawhar/legion#2228) drops repeats. Lane receipts stay; RequestCoreTo also requires the stream's PubAck. The role lane moves to one queue group across listeners (fallback to per-machine when the grant lacks it), non-blocking receipt waits, no pending limit. EV-12, EV-10/EP-21, EV-14, EV-15 fixed. Listener grant gains session-consumer API; session grant unchanged; a listener without the grant answers registrations core (today's path).

findings.finding: Listener grant cannot be scoped to s-* consumers (wildcards are whole tokens); host users share the listener grant with their sessions; a grant change replaces the hub VM
findings.answer: Accepted wider listener grant on the trusted listener, Dispatch and host users (host sessions already share the listener's durable grants); session grant unchanged; INFRA-14 carries it at INFRA-553's one replacement or a later live reload; listener falls back to core without it; natslive test proves the members user is refused.

findings.finding: Removing core delivery would drop unstored topics, role-held notice subjects, and every frame against an older listener
findings.answer: Registration answer carries mode consumer or core; core keeps today's path; unstored topics and role-held notice subjects stay core in both modes; test against a listener without the field.

findings.finding: Durable role delivery rests on a core publish being stored after the receipt
findings.answer: RequestCoreTo succeeds only with both the PubAck and the receipt; missing PubAck returns ErrForwardNotStored mapped to delivery_failed; test with no stream.

findings.finding: Durable role forwards reverse the live-only design and can deliver stale role messages and ad-hoc copies
findings.answer: The spec requires role topics across restarts; stored forwards and ad-hoc copies are shown when they arrive; docs/solutions page and AGENTS.md updated; INFRA-14 agreed role lanes stay core.

findings.finding: Follow updates the filter only at the next registration; overlapping filters refused
findings.answer: Filter updated inside the subscribe call before it answers; envoy_subscribe calls it immediately; containment reduction and common-prefix widening with plugin-side drop; tests for a publish 100 ms after a follow and overlapping follows.

findings.finding: Ack on done conflicts with order and the 1 s p99
findings.answer: received at decode is the timed receipt; done after write acks; MaxAckPending 1,024, AckWait 60 s with progress every 20 s, MaxDeliver unlimited; held-frame test.

findings.finding: Ownership across listeners and replicas and restart resume unspecified
findings.answer: Owner is the entry's machine id and, within a machine, the task holding the durable binding; serving-port owner is the interest's machine; relay set from the watched cache; restart at ack floor on every relay start; listener-kill test.

findings.finding: bus.Client holds one subscription of each kind
findings.answer: New session-consumer client on its own connection with the jetstream package; role lane on its own connection; message INFRA-546/547/548 implementers before editing shared files.

findings.finding: Relay subject hits the live lane; any session can forge done
findings.answer: Live lane skips notifications.envoy.deliver.>; forged done accepted and documented, same exposure as today's notifications.> reads.

findings.finding: Hub-side JetStream cost unmeasured
findings.answer: Load table adds nats-server CPU, RSS, consumer count and pull-request rate; replicas three per INFRA-14, numbers to INFRA-14 before any change.

findings.finding: Return horizon unbounded
findings.answer: InactiveThreshold equals stream retention; floor below first sequence shows #2228's gap notice.

findings.finding: A late targeted frame could run a BTW model call
findings.answer: A frame with Envoy-Delivered over 1 or stored before the current epoch never starts a side turn; shown as a card (INFRA-439 guarantee).

findings.finding: Role-lane change needs a grant change; pending limits drop; remaining senders unclear
findings.answer: Grant adds envoy-roles and keeps the per-machine entry; fallback on refusal; non-blocking handler, own connection, pending limits off, slow-consumer counter; test with a silent holder at 40 msg/s.

findings.finding: Claude Code done signal has no source; bridge acks before writing
findings.answer: Bridge mode adds --replay-user-messages (present in 2.1.311) and acks on the echo; channel mode acks on the awaited notification write, documented; bridge change owned here.

findings.finding: Removing /v1/replay reaches other trees
findings.answer: Not removed: INFRA-14 requires it until no registered plugin needs it; grant stays; INFRA-547's soak case keeps working.

findings.finding: Plugin cursor shape differs from #2228's
findings.answer: Resume point is stream id plus the sequence below which nothing is held unwritten; used only when the consumer is missing.

findings.finding: Load bullet has no threshold; 10x cannot commit on main; harness unaware of the new protocol
findings.answer: From-publish p99 at most 1 s gated, from-arrival reported; direct NATS publish mode where Dispatch cannot commit; harness sessions taught consumer delivery here (departure 2).

findings.finding: Live-test disruptions and check undefined; Claude Code mode unproven in the pod
findings.answer: Committed script with six disruptions, three topic kinds, two session kinds, exactly-once and order check, negative controls; bridge mode measured to run (claude -p in pod); channel mode tried under script, else reported.

findings.finding: Stored and forwarded once and no stall need commands
findings.answer: TestRoleLane counts stored forwards and forwards per listener and measures the other role's receipt p99.

findings.finding: Docs list short and unchecked
findings.answer: List extended (envoy AGENTS.md, skills/envoy, docs/solutions page, tool-contract.ts, infra docs); a grep per file.

findings.finding: Rollout outside the repo
findings.answer: Any order works by the mode answer; dist rebuilt in the same commit; releases from main; grant reaches the hub through INFRA-14.

findings.finding: EV-10 and EV-14 scope
findings.answer: Subject index and skip before decode with a benchmark; HTTP push kept for OpenCode with per-session workers and consumer relay.

specDepartures.spec: Replay after a reconnect is driven by the stored stream, not by polling on a heartbeat.
specDepartures.plan: Consumer delivery replaces polling whenever the listener confirms it; the plugin keeps #2228's polling catch-up and the listener keeps POST /v1/replay as the fallback for listeners without the consumer grant and older plugins.
specDepartures.evidence: INFRA-14 architect, Envoy 2026-10-27 04:24Z: the listener must keep working without the grant, and /v1/replay keeps answering until no registered session's plugin needs it.
